verdict.rationale: Autumn ships an MCP server explicitly for AI assistants to do 'billing actions, plan management' (autumn-docs-7, autumn-docs-25) plus API endpoints for attaching plans/subscriptions and previewing charges (autumn-docs-13, autumn-docs-20), which supports an agent driving billing setup programmatically. However, product/price definition is primarily done via the `atmn` CLI + `autumn.config.ts` file and pushed (autumn-docs-5, autumn-docs-14, autumn-docs-15) rather than a documented single API call, and there's no explicit endpoint shown for generating a standalone 'payment link' for a new product in one session (only checkout/portal-style attach and openCustomerPortal exist). Missing for 10: a documented API for programmatic product/price creation (vs config-file/CLI), explicit payment-link generation endpoint, and a concrete end-to-end example of an agent doing all three steps in one session.
